title: Senior Python & FastAPI Backend Engineer
description: We are seeking an experienced Backend Engineer to design and scale high-throughput REST APIs and microservices. You will build asynchronous services with FastAPI, design performant PostgreSQL schemas, cache critical data in Redis, and deploy containerized services using Docker and Kubernetes in a modern CI/CD pipeline.

title: Frontend React & TypeScript Developer
description: Join our product team to build responsive, accessible web applications. You will translate Figma designs into pixel-perfect React components, manage state with Redux/Zustand, optimize client-side rendering with Next.js, and style modern interfaces using Tailwind CSS.

title: Machine Learning & NLP Engineer
description: Looking for an applied ML Engineer to lead our NLP recommendation systems. Responsibilities include building text extraction pipelines, training sentence embedding models, developing semantic search indices, fine-tuning LLMs, and performing offline evaluation with metrics like NDCG and MRR.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Node / React / AWS)
description: Full stack engineer needed to develop user-facing web applications and GraphQL APIs. You will work across the entire stack: React on the frontend, Node.js and Express on backend services, MongoDB for document storage, and AWS infrastructure (ECS, Lambda, S3).

title: Site Reliability & Cloud Platform Engineer
description: We are looking for a DevOps/SRE specialist to maintain our multi-region Kubernetes clusters, automate cloud infrastructure via Terraform on AWS, build robust GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, and implement observability using Prometheus and Grafana.

title: QA Automation Engineer
description: Develop and maintain automated end-to-end and API testing suites. Write test cases in Python using pytest and Playwright/Selenium, validate REST APIs with Postman, and integrate test suites directly into CI pipelines to guarantee software reliability.

title: Junior Software Developer (Backend / Python)
description: Great opportunity for a junior engineer or recent graduate to learn and contribute to real-world production web services. You will build REST endpoints with Python and FastAPI, write database queries, and collaborate using Git.

title: Data Analyst & Business Intelligence
description: Transform raw business and user interaction data into actionable insights. Build interactive dashboards in Tableau/PowerBI, write complex SQL aggregations, and perform exploratory data analysis with Python and pandas.
